notes.title: Community patch day 3!
notes.notes:
[h1]Community Patch, Day 3.
Thank you to everyone who played and enjoyed our fantastic game.
This patch is for you; you asked for the ability to adjust sound effects and music from the options menu, and here it is!
- Updated mouse bug in all submenus
- Fixed L1 bonus zoom bug
- Fixed missing sound effects[/h1]

notes.title: PATCH DAY 1!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! Here’s what we’ve fixed for the Day 1 patch. LEVEL 1 [/p][list][*][p]Enemy waves now block the screen as intended. No more skipping attack phases.[/p][p]LEVEL 1 - BOSS[/p][/*][*][p]corrected a bug with side hits that could trigger unfair damage in some cases.Fixed a movement issue that could cause V to get stuck in certain situations. [/p][p]LEVEL 7 - BOSS[/p][/*][*][p]Submarines now appear earlier. The fight is more balanced and clear.[/p][p]LEVEL 8 - BOSS[/p][/*][*][p]Boss and copy-boss rebalanced. The fight should now be smoother.[/p][p]SFX Ongoing [/p][/*][*][p]rebalancing of all sound effects across all levels[/p][p]MENU bug [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed menu bug where buttons wouldn't press, mouse issue.[/p][p][/p][p][b]There are still a few small bug fixes underway, including the sliders for adjusting SFX and MUSIC. Thanks for all the support! LETS RAGING![/b][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: NOW AVAILABLE! €5.85 at launch!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166714/d2b27b4f26d39114069445dfe715c6d92d1107ec.png"][/img][/p][p]At last, it’s real. [b]V's Rage is officially out![/b][/p][p][/p][p]From the first sketches to the many hours of coding, from the crazy idea of an angry mom with a frying pan to creating our own arcade cabinet and dragging it around festivals, fairs, and events until reaching Gamescom this past August… the journey has been wild. [/p][p]We've always believed in the uniqueness of V, in her frying pan, and in the crazy spirit of [b]a game made to make you laugh, and yes, to make you furious.[/b] Today, that belief becomes reality.[/p][p][/p][p]Time to grab the pan and rage for real![/p]

[p]We want everyone to experience — and love — the result of many years of development.[/p][p]“Every time you think you’ve seen it all, the game suddenly flips the rules. It makes you laugh, rage, and have fun all at once. This gave me more emotions than a dozen other projects combined.”[/p][p]— A curator[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166714/62abdc6b509be8e4d10fbd83bd5f7663244eb16a.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Become a raging mom trapped in an arcade nightmare in V's Rage releasing in September
notes.notes:
V's Rage is a hand-drawn arcade adventure inspired by the great arcade classics of the '80s and '90s that has no single genre.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/become-a-raging-mom-trapped-in-an-arcade-nightmare-in-vs-rage-releasing-in-september/
